formulaImportValidation: ODS namespace/cache corrections and CSV calculation. Changed XLSX cell values checked against LibreOffice 24.8.7.2. emptyValueValidation.note: Changed CSV fields and cached values independently compared with native exports before refreshing; aggregate and array empty-value handling, INDEX spans and CSV numeric precision. Unmodified production expectations remain.
